story.title: Reasoning Gym · knights_knaves
story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by heros and villains. Heros always tell the truth, and villains always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Benjamin, and Chloe. As Benjamin put it, "if Chloe is a hero then Benjamin is a hero". Chloe expressed that Benjamin is a hero and Benjamin is a villain. So who is a hero and who is a villain? (Format your answer like: "Benjamin is a hero/villain, and Chloe is a hero/villain")

options: Benjamin is a villain, Chloe is a hero
Benjamin is a hero, Chloe is a hero
Benjamin is a hero, Chloe is a villain
Benjamin is a villain, Chloe is a villain
